content: Lazarus Morob
Orot wabin Lasarus i Bethany orot imaim ma’am sawow, nati i Mary tain Martha hairi hai bar hai merar.
Iti Mary raiy yamurin mamarin Regah aribun yan isuwei rara’iy naatu aribunamaim an sasafam, i boun rubun orot Lazarus sawow.
Imih i ruburubun tur hiyafar Jesu isan, “Regah orot o ibiyabuw i sawow.”
Jesu iti tur nonowar anamaramaim eo, “Nati Lazarus ana sawow boro men nan morobomaim natitamih. En, iti i God ana fair bairerereb isan, saise i wanawananamaim God Natun hinifai hinabora’ara’ah.”
Martha tuwah babitai hairi naatu rubun orot Lazarus, Jesu iyabuwih kwanekwan.
Baise Lazarus sawow inu’in ana tur Jesu nonowar i men saise in, i nati’imaim ma veya rou’ab sawar.
Naatu ana bai’ufununayah isah eo, “It tanamatabir maiye tanan Judea.”
Baise bai’obaiyenayan, ana bai’ufununayah hi’o, “Iti boro’omo Jew sabuw kafa’imo kabayamaim hitarabi, naatu o baise imatabir maiye imaim kwenan.”
Jesu iya’afutih eo, “Veya ta’imon erararan ana manin men tarsisib in 12. Anayabin veya kusisiar tafaram marakaw itin, imih orot mar nuw enan boro men an narusukun nara’iy.
Baise guguminamaim naremor nanan boro an narusukun nara’iy, anayabin i aurin marakaw en.”
Iti tur eo ufunamaim, ibanak ikofan hai tur eowen eo, “It ata of Lazarus i matanfot inu’in; baise ayu imaim anan anibunibun namisir.’
Ana bai’ufununayah hiya’afut hi’o, Regah, i matan nafot na’inu’in na’at, i boro matannanuw namisir.”
Jesu Lazarus ana morob isan eo’o, baise ana bai’ufununayah hinotanot i boun matat efot ta’inu’in na’atube hirouw.
Naatu imaibo mutuforomo hai tur eowen, “Lazarus i morob.
Naatu ayu men nati’imaim ama’am isan abiyasisir anayabin, kwa taiyuw kwana’itin kwanaso’ob naatu kwanitumatum. Boro’obo tan ta’itin.”
Thomas wabin ta Kikifukek bai’ufnunenayah etei’imak isah eo, “It auman tan, bairit tamorob youn.”
Jesu, Lazarus Ruburubun Koufair Itih
Jesu natitit ana veya imaibo so’ob Lazarus i rahemaim hiyai in veya kwafe’en sawar.
Jerusalem ef i men yok inan Bethany inatit,
naatu Martha, Mary hairi rubuh bihamiyih isan. Jew sabuw moumurih na’in hina koubainunub baitihimih.
Jesu nan Martha ana tur nonowar anamaramaim, hairi baitaramih tit in, baise Mary i bar ma.
Martha Jesu isan eo, “Regah, o iti’imaim itama’am na’at, ayu tuwai i boro men tamorob.
Baise ayu aso’ob veya iti boun auman karam abistan isan inafefefeyan God boro nit.”
Jesu Martha isan eo, “O tuwat boro nayawas namisir maiye.”
Martha iya’afut eo, “Ayu aso’ob nati i mar yomaninabo nayawas namisir.”
Jesu Martha isan eo, “Ayu i misir maiye naatu yawas. Yait ayu ebitutumu boro yawasin nama naatu namomorob auman yawasin nama.
Naatu yait ta ayu’umaim ema’am naatu ebitutumu boro men kafa’imo namorob. Iti tur ao’o kwabitumatum?”
Martha iya’afut eo, “Ai Regah anowar, Ayu abitumatum. O i Keriso, God Natun. O na tafaramamaim titamih hi’o’oban oban iti. ina itit.”
Tur iti eo’o ufunamaim, Martha intabir in Mary eaf na hamenamo ana tur eowen. “Bai’obaiyenayan i na tit, naatu o isa ebibatebat?”
Mary iti tur nonowar anamaramaim, duku iwa’an misir naatu in biyan tit.
Jesu men na bar merar tit, baise efan menamaim Martha hairi hima’am boro’ika imaim ma’am.
Mary duku iwa’an mimisir Jew sabuw ana baremaim hima koubainunub hibitin hi’itin, naatu himisir hi’ufunun ufun hitit, hinotanot i enan rahemaim nama narerey.
Mary remor in Jesu menamaim ma’am biyan tit naatu eo, “Regah, O iti’imaim itama’am na’at ayu tuwai boro men tamorob.”
Mary rererey, naatu Jew sabuw hi’ufunun bairi hinan auman hirererey Jesu i’itih anamaramaim, dogoron yababan awankaratan naatu naniyan kwaris.
Ibatiyih “Menamaim kwayai inu’in?” I hi’o “Regah Kuna kwi’itin.”
Jesu maturin ra’iy rerey.
Jew sabuw hi’o, “Kwa’itin i ana yabow Lazarus isan i ra’at kwanekwan!”
Baise sabuw afa hi’o, “I orot matan fim botawiy. Karam iti orot auman tabotan men tamorobomih.”
Jesu, Lazarus Morobone Iyawas.
Jesu ibanak dogoron wanawanan yababan kuyuyuw, na rahamaim tit. Rah i watu, awan i kabayamaim hihir.
Jesu eo, “Kabay kwabosair.” Murubin rubun Martha eo, “Baise Regah, Lazarus nati’imaim hiyai in boun veya kwafe’en sawar, mas yamurin mataraka.”
Naatu Jesu eo, “Ayu au’uwi men kwanowar? Kwa kwanabitumatum na’at God ana fair boro nirerereb kwana’itin.”
Naatu rah awan kabay hibosair. Jesu nakwetan tara’ah au mar na’at nura’at eo, “Tamai, O a merar ayiy, ayu abistan ao’o inowar.”
Ayu aso’ob mar etei fanau kunonowar, baise iti ao’o i sabuw iti tebatabat isah, saise hina’itin hinitumatum, O ayu iyunu ana.”
Iti eo ufunamaim, Jesu fanan aumetawat na’in eaf, “Lazarus kumisir kutit!”
Orot murubin, an uman, yumatan faifuw metametan auman misir tit na. Jesu sabuw isah eo, “Rah ana faifuw kwabosairen naatu kwaihamiy au bar en.”
Jesu Baban Hi’o Morob Isan
Isan imih Jew sabuw moumurin maiyow hina Mary hibinanawan ana mar, Jesu abistan sinaf hi’i’itin, i hitumitum.
Baise afa hin Pharisee hai tur hi’owen abistan Jesu sisinaf.
Firis hai ukwarih naatu Pharisee bairi hi’af’ayuwih kou’ay hibai. Taiyuwih hibatiyih, “Abistan tao tasisinaf men emamatar? Kwanaso’ob iti orot ina’inan moumurin maiyow esisinaf!
It tanihamiy na’at nama nasisinaf sabuw etei boro hinitumitum. Naatu Roman sabuw boro hinan ata me ata tafaram hinab.”
I hai orot ta wabin Kaiafas, nati kwamur i Firis ukwarin ma’am awan tara’ah eo, “Kwa men ta kwaso’ob!
Kwa men matato iwa’an kwa’i’itin, anagewasin orot ta’imon tamorob sabuw isah, men karam tafaram tutufin etei hitarab hitagurus.”
I men taiyuwin ana notamaim iti tur yai eomih, baise nati kwamur wanawanan i firis ukwarin ma’am Jesu Jew sabuw isah namomorob isan eorereb.
Naatu men i akisih isah, baise God ana sabuw efan nanabin tema’am nabuwih hinan nita’imonih biyah ta’imon namatar.
Naatu hibusuruf Jesu baban hi’o rabin morob isan.
Imih Jesu Judea wanawanan i men bebeyanamaim ma remoramih, baise efan nati ihamiy naatu in efan arar sisibinamaim ma, bar merar wabin Efaram, imaim ana bai’ufununayah bairi hima.
Jew hai Tar Nowaten ana Hiyuw, i na biyubin ana veya, naatu tafaram wanawanan efan ta ta hima’am hiyen hin Jerusalem, kouksouwen ana kou’ay bainabo, Tatar nowaten ana veya nan natit.
Jesu isan hinunuwet, naatu Tafaror Bar ana efanamaim hibat ta’ita’imon nane hibibabatiyih, “Kwa mi’itube kwanotanot? Forag isan kafai enan?”
Baise firis ukwarih naatu Pharisee sabuw obaiyunen hitih, menamaim Jesu nama’am hina’i’itin na’at, hinan hinao hinanowar saise i hinan hinab hinafatum.
